positions.as_written: Read a new biomechanical study by asking which of these seven gaps it narrows, since most narrow none.
Treat a cohort recruited at presentation as unable to answer a natural history question, however large it is.
Consider their age and physiology, because the time horizon changes which uncertainties matter.
Consider their comorbidities, since these narrow the options uncertainty applies to.
Consider the demands on their knee, because that is what makes one gap relevant and another academic.
Consider their psychological state, since tolerance of uncertainty varies more between patients than almost anything else here.
